Always great!
Aug 2024 • Friends
We came a couple of times for food and drinks with various people. All of them have always left with a great experience. From Pizza to Pasta...home-made cold cuts, great salads and some main dishes... all the food been served was top! Great beer, wine and other liquor selection for very very reasonable prices.
Service is maybe not always the most professional but all members of the service are friendly, welcoming, attentive and care for you as customer... nothing else you need when coming to an Italian style pub! A big plus is the ambiance - very casual seating and well-designed as a pub! We definitely will come back for a drink or two or three or four! Cheers!
